The Throne of the Dead has fallen

As the black spire broke and the green flames died, the northern sky cleared for the first time in years. The bells of Astera rang all night. But what lay beneath the ruins of the throne was not the Lord of the Dead. It was a door opening onto somewhere deeper, and from beyond the door, someone was looking back.
